_comment: Rotation state for the scheduled code-review sweep. A slice is one plugin (a folder name shared across the app/api, components, lib, and mobile layers, reviewed together) or one standalone module (a folder name in just one layer). Each run reviews an in-progress slice first, then any never-reviewed slice, then the least-recently-reviewed one, so every slice gets at least one pass. `cursor`/`partial` carry a too-big slice across runs so nothing is dropped. New slices start unreviewed (lastReviewedAt: null); slices whose folders are gone are pruned. Maintained by ctf/scripts/reviewCodebaseSlice.mjs and committed back by .github/workflows/code-review-sweep.yml. Safe to edit by hand.
